assignmentHtml.task: Research Alfredo Larin YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who is Alfredo Larin? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Alfredo Larin is #29/#30 with ~64-65B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Alfredo Larin with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Comprehensive dossier for Alfredo Larin YouTube channel:

(1) STABLE CHANNEL ID AND CANONICAL URL:

  • Channel ID: UCd5ApCORQsMOZZz5E9oVeFA
  • Handle: @alfredolarin
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@alfredolarin
    Sources: YouTube channel page itself [1]; SocialBlade [2]

(2) OPERATOR/CREATOR:
Alfredo Larin is a Salvadoran YouTuber, TikToker, and comedian based in El Salvador. He was born in Ahuachapán, El Salvador. His channel is self-operated — he is the primary creator, performer, and face of the channel. Multiple sources describe him as a 'Salvadoran YouTuber known for his comedy & vlogging shorts' [3]. There is conflicting information on his birth date: October 14, 2000 (EverybodyWiki [4]) versus August 20, 1993 (FamousBirthdays [5], Sportskeeda [6]).

(3) CHANNEL CREATION DATE AND EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD:

  • Channel created: April 9, 2017 (Wikitubia [3], SocialBlade [2])
  • First video uploaded: January 3, 2018, titled 'Mi primer video / Alfredo Larin' (Wikitubia [3]; verified directly on YouTube [7])
  • This earliest upload remains publicly accessible with ~4.5 million views as of September 2026 [7].

(4) OPERATING LOCATION AND DISPLAYED COUNTRY:

  • Country: El Salvador, consistently listed across Wikipedia [8], Wikitubia [3], and Vidiq (as reported in search snippet) [9]
  • Residence: El Salvador (Sportskeeda [6])
  • Content frequently references Salvadoran culture, locations, and Spanish-language humor.

(5) LANGUAGES:

  • Primary language: Spanish (Wikipedia list of most-viewed channels [8])
  • All video titles, descriptions, and spoken content are in Spanish.

(6) PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY:

  • Wikipedia classification: Entertainment [8]
  • Wikitubia style tags: Vlogging, Comedy & Entertainment [3]
  • Content is predominantly short-form comedy skits featuring family life, pranks, challenges, and cooking segments.

(7) CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL:

  • Primarily self-produced short-form content (YouTube Shorts), originally created for TikTok and cross-posted to YouTube. According to Wikitubia: 'In 2023, he started uploading his TikTok videos onto YouTube as YouTube Shorts,' which gave the channel its massive growth boost [3].
  • Content features recurring characters played by Alfredo himself plus family members (wife Yudy/Yudith, son Larin Jr., pets Moly and Sally) [10].
  • Also includes occasional long-form vlogs and compilations.
  • The channel has ~2,300 videos [2], overwhelmingly Shorts format.

(8) REPRESENTATIVE WORKS:

  • 'Mi primer video / Alfredo Larin' (Jan 3, 2018) — earliest upload, 4.5M views [7]
  • 'LA GRAN ESTAFA #comedia' (Feb 13, 2024) — ~278.6M views, 4.1M likes [11]
  • 'LARIN SE QUEDÓ EN MEDIO DEL MAR' (#SHORTS #humor) — ~302M views [12]
  • Mango preparation video with daughter — 33M+ views (referenced by FamousBirthdays [5] and Sportskeeda [6])
  • 'LARIN DE LUTO' (#SHORTS #humor) — ~27M views [12]
  • Compilations such as '@alfredolarin Lo Mejor de Alfredo Larin | Videos Virales y Bromas' (36M views, hosted on third-party channel Lyra Camping) [12]

STATISTICAL SNAPSHOT (as of September 2026):

  • Subscribers: ~60.2M [1][2]
  • Total views: ~64.7B (SocialBlade daily data shows 64,772,223,118 on Sep 10, 2026) [2]
  • Video count: ~2,300 [2]
  • Ranked #32 among most-viewed YouTube channels globally [8]
  • Estimated monthly earnings: $126K–$2M (SocialBlade) [2]

evidence.supports: Channel handle, subscriber count, video count, canonical URL

He reached 30 million subscribers on February 9, 2024.
